To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the word embedding models are not very certain about the similarity score, and that a threshold can be applied to filter the most similar terms.

(1) the similarity scores of the word embedding model is not a perfect indicator for term relatedness and (2) the threshold for term similarity can be effectively determined based on the uncertainty of the similarity scores.
the similarity scores from word embedding models are not as reliable as they seem to be and a threshold can be used to effectively filter highly related terms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the similarity score can be used to identify the most related terms.
the uncertainty factor of similarity scores in word embedding and its application in filtering out highly related terms.
how to effectively use the similarity scores of word embeddings for subsequent tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thresholding approach can effectively filter the highly related term pairs and can be used in any task that requires a threshold on the relatedness of terms.
word embedding similarity scores are indeed meaningful and can be used for subsequent tasks.
the thresholding of the similarity score of the word embedding model is a useful and promising technique to filter out the highly related terms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the similarity score of word embedding can be used for term relatedness estimation but only if the threshold is applied to the score.
, the uncertainty of the word embedding model is a useful factor in filtering out the highly related terms, which can be used to improve the performance of downstream tasks.
the similarity value obtained from the embedding models is not a deterministic value, but a random value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the word embedding models are not as certain as we expect them to be.
the similarity score from word embedding models is not always a trustworthy indicator and a proper thresholding is needed to obtain a meaningful result.
we need to be cautious in using the similarity score obtained with neural word embedding.
